scope: ChatGPT transport/rendering failure vs durable QROS execution continuity

reported_symptom.description: After a user continuation order begins executing, visible progress disappears and the client returns to the user's order showing that it could not be sent, preventing apparent forward progress.

external_service_evidence.finding: Recent September 2026 incidents included elevated errors affecting GPT-5.6 paid plans and ChatGPT Work; those incidents were reported resolved.
OpenAI documents transient server, network/WebSocket, and long-conversation failure modes that can cause generation, connection, freezing or rendering failures.

repository_findings.finding: Current chat handoff is stale: it pins V254 and explicitly requires fail-closed if the stable pointer differs.
Current durable W09C checkpoint still records semantic mask rematerialization IN_PROGRESS rather than closed.

A later volatile chat/runtime execution reached 24/24 semantic groups plus merge/oracle PASS, but those receipts are no longer recoverable in the active runtime and were not durably committed before the UI/transport interruption.

root_cause_assessment.confirmed_qros_process_defect: Durable persistence occurred too late relative to long/heavy execution. The client conversation was still carrying state that should already have been committed to durable authority.
root_cause_assessment.confirmed_handoff_defect: CURRENT_CHAT_HANDOFF was not regenerated when stable scientific authority advanced from V254 to V255.

corrective_actions: Regenerate CURRENT_CHAT_HANDOFF from V255 and pin the current durable W09C checkpoint.
Treat duplicate/retried user continuation orders idempotently.
Persist every independently expensive shard/group/chunk receipt before launching the next expensive unit.
Do not promote volatile-only results to VERIFIED; if their receipts are lost, resume from the last durable checkpoint.
Keep economic PnL, holdout, GA2 and new GA1 closed.
